items.label: Market insights, Mg Mg, Developers have begun testing the Alpenglow upgrade on Solana's public testnet. It replaces TowerBFT consensus with Votor, enabling validators to finalize blocks after one or two direct voting rounds. This targets a reduction in finality time from about 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds without changing how users send transactions or how applications execute them. Validators must run Agave 4.3 for initial testing, with alternative clients like Firedancer not yet supported. A tentative mainnet feature activation for related changes is listed for September 28 but the full Alpenglow launch remains unconfirmed pending test results., Forward Industries announced a $25 million registered direct offering with an institutional investor. The company intends to use the proceeds to acquire additional SOL and grow its treasury. It previously added approximately 357,000 SOL and equivalents between early August and mid-September, bringing total holdings to roughly 8.16 million SOL. Other entities such as DeFi Development Corp have also reported increasing their SOL treasury positions in recent weeks. This activity points to continued corporate interest in SOL as a treasury asset., AI generated • 18h ago
